wiki.title: Gil Cisneros
wiki.extract: Gilbert Ray Cisneros Jr. (born February 12, 1971) is an American politician and former naval officer serving as the U.S. representative for California's 31st congressional district since 2025. A member of the Democratic Party, he previously served as Under Secretary of Defense for Personnel and Readiness in the Biden administration and was the U.S. representative for California's 39th congressional district from 2019 to 2021.
